name: model-split-screen
description: Make the "same prompt, two models" comparison video that every model launch produces (Claude Fable 5.2 vs Opus 5.5, Seedance vs Kling, Eevee vs Cycles): run one prompt twice under the same rules, log the real time and cost of each run, then lay the two results side by side (1920×1080) or stacked (1080×1920), started on the same frame, each with its name and its time and cost under it, optionally blind ("A" and "B" until the last seconds, then the reveal) and with a winner frame. scripts/split.py does the layout with ffmpeg and Pillow, so it works with an ffmpeg built without drawtext. Use when someone asks for a model comparison video, "Fable vs Opus", "same prompt two models", a side-by-side or split-screen comparison with cost and time, a blind "guess which one" test, or A/B of two renders or two edits. Not for a split screen inside a story edit (varg-video-edit-library), comparing many models in a grid of stills (gpt-image-2-6), or making the clips themselves (blender-code-film, code-game-trailer, varg-ai).
